narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating obligated $916M in FY2026 to date. The vendor recorded 2 awards for the period with an average award size of $458M, and obligations are up 361.8% year over year. American Centrifuge Operating shows a concentrated market footprint: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing accounts for $900M of obligations and Nuclear Electric Power Generation accounts for $15.9M. Obligations by fiscal year rose from $38.9M in FY21, to $42.9M in FY22, to $50M in FY23, to $85M in FY24, to $198M in FY25, and to $916M in FY26. The current-year totals are fiscal year to date and contract obligations unless noted otherwise. This profile reflects a few very large awards driving a large year-to-date total and a high average award size relative to the award count.
